test_payload.prompt: First tell me the current time, then compute 25 + 17, and finally multiply that result by 3.

config.system_message: You are a careful assistant. You MUST use the available tools for any calculation or to obtain the current time. Do not compute mentally. Always call describe_tool before using a tool whose schema you do not yet know.

current_time.name: current_time
current_time.description: Return the current UTC timestamp as ISO-8601. Takes no parameters.

add.name: add
add.description: Add two numbers. Inputs: a (number), b (number). Returns a + b.
add.summary: Sum of two numbers a and b.

multiply.name: multiply
multiply.description: Multiply two numbers. Inputs: a (number), b (number). Returns a * b.
multiply.summary: Product of two numbers a and b.
